dedupe_keys.name: raib rail accident investigation branch reports great britain

description: The GOV.UK finder lists the investigation reports of the Rail Accident Investigation Branch, the independent body that investigates railway and tramway accidents and incidents in Great Britain. On 2026-09-29 the newest entries included a collision between a passenger train and rail handling trolleys at Queens Park (9 May 2026), Report 10/2026 on a tram striking two pedestrians in Sheffield, a discontinuation report on a tram derailment in Manchester, and Report 09/2026 on a portable access ramp occurrence at Norwood Junction. Reports describe the sequence of events, causes and recommendations. Coverage: mainline railways, metros and tramways in Great Britain. Format and access: web pages with PDF reports, filterable in the finder. Licence and cost: free; the GOV.UK footer puts content under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated. Caveats: narrative reports, not a structured database, so events must be coded by the user. It supports resilience and hazard exposure studies that need documented failure sequences, and validation of models against real events. It relates to the Carmont derailment investigation, the NTSB CAROL database and the JTSB railway reports in the catalogue.
